title: Working with Text
introduction: Text values can be compared, searched, split and formatted, but details such as case and whitespace matter.
learningOutcomes: Normalise text for an appropriate comparison.

activities.question: Which operation commonly removes surrounding whitespace?
activities.explanation: Trimming removes whitespace at the beginning and end of text.

activities.question: Text comparison should always ignore case in every application.
activities.explanation: The correct comparison depends on the domain; identifiers and passwords may have different rules from casual commands.

activities.question: Breaking text into pieces around a delimiter is commonly called ___.
activities.explanation: A split operation produces parts separated by a chosen delimiter.
